name: Vantaige

sources.title: List Your AI Tool — full pricing ladder: free queue ($0, badge+backlink required, 2–4wk), Verified $25, Featured $49/30d or $99/90d, Spotlight $189; manual review 3–5 business days

conditions: Free basic listing exists but requires embedding the 'Featured on Vantaige' badge + backlink on your public site footer — verified before approval; free queue review takes 2–4 weeks
requirements: AI tools across all categories (writing, image, coding, video, audio, marketing, agents) — 'If it uses AI, it belongs here'
Tool must be 'live, functional, and genuinely useful' — they verify the website works, the description is accurate, and the category is correct

Free path: add the Vantaige badge snippet to the tool's website footer; paid paths (Verified $25, Featured $49–99, Spotlight $189) skip the badge requirement and get DoFollow links + priority 1–4 day review
preparation: Tool name, URL, logo, accurate description, category
Decide free vs paid: free needs the badge snippet live on your site before review
For paid: $25 (Verified badge, one-time) up to $189 (Spotlight: category + homepage rail + sponsored story)
Signup/account likely required (nav shows Log in / Sign up)
workflow: Open https://vantaige.io/list-your-ai-tool and pick a listing path (free queue or paid)
If free: embed the badge code from /badge on your tool's footer first
Submit tool details via the 3-step submit flow
Manual review: 3–5 business days standard, 1–4 days priority for paid, 2–4 weeks for the free queue
Confirmation email when live; listing page carries the Verified badge on paid paths
watchFor: The 'free' listing is not costless — it requires a permanent badge+backlink on your site
Site self-reports ~20K monthly visitors with +300% MoM growth (GA4, Jul–Sep 2026) — unverified third-party
Paid placements buy 'inventory and speed, not approval' — listings can still be rejected
Updates currently require contacting support (self-serve portal 'in progress')
countsAsLive: A tool detail page exists under vantaige.io/ai-tools with the product's name, logo, category, and a link out — confirmed by their 'tool is live' email
unknowns: Whether free-path outbound links are dofollow (paid paths explicitly are)
Refund terms for rejected paid listings (a /listing-refund-policy page exists but was not read)
Whether non-AI SaaS is accepted — copy says AI tools only
